memoryNodes.cue: A paper image has a digital copy.
The menu has a default setting.
A dated device is no longer used.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 标日期的设备已不再使用。

data.situation:
At the archive screen, visitors could compare an old paper photograph with its digitized version. A note used digitalized for the conversion into digital form. Jo wanted to send the image to her smartphone, but the demonstration file was too large. The guide showed how software could compress it. The interface had a clear default setting and a short menu, which Maya found user-friendly. Behind the screen, an obsolete device was displayed with its date and former purpose. The new menu was easier to understand, although the guide did not promise that every compressed file would keep the same quality. Jo: Will compressing the file remove part of the picture?
Guide: It depends on the method and settings. This is only the display example.
Maya: Can we restore the default?
Guide: Yes. That button returns this menu to its initial setting.

readingBlocks.zh: 档案屏让游客比较旧纸照片和数字版本；说明以 digitalized 表示转换成数字形式。乔想把影像发到智能手机，但演示文件太大。讲解员展示软件如何压缩文件。界面有清晰的默认设置和简短菜单，玛雅觉得易用。屏幕后，过时设备附有日期和曾经用途。新菜单更容易理解，不过讲解员没有承诺所有压缩文件都能保持相同质量。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Will compressing the file remove part of the picture?
Guide: It depends on the method and settings. This is only the display example.
Maya: Can we restore the default?
Guide: Yes. That button returns this menu to its initial setting.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：压缩会去掉部分画面吗？
讲解员：取决于方法和设置，这里只是展示例子。
玛雅：可以恢复默认设置吗？
讲解员：可以，那个按钮让菜单恢复初始设置。

glossary.zh: 通过处理使文件所占空间减小；压缩

externalEvidence.definition: make more compact by or as if by pressing

glossary.zh: 用户与软件交互的界面
glossary.note: 这里指用户界面；a user interface。
glossary.example: The interface had a short menu.

externalEvidence.definition: (computer science) a program that controls a display for the user (usually on a computer monitor) and that allows the user to interact with the system

glossary.zh: 未另作选择时采用的默认设置
glossary.note: 默认选项；by default 表示按默认设置。

externalEvidence.definition: an option that is selected automatically unless an alternative is specified

glossary.zh: 容易理解和使用的；易用的
glossary.note: 设备或软件容易使用；a user-friendly interface。

glossary.zh: 因被替代等已不再使用的；过时的
glossary.note: 已经过时、不再使用的；不一定是坏了。
glossary.example: An obsolete device stood behind the screen.
glossary.exampleZh: 屏幕后放着已过时的设备。
